description: Rename a suite or change what its description says. Its tests, runs and schedules stay with it. Two suites of a project cannot share a name. To change which tests it holds, use change_suite_tests.

description.description: What the suite is for; empty removes it.
description.title: Description

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

suite.description: The suite's id or name, as list_suites shows it. 'core' is the Core suite.
suite.title: Suite

name: update_suite
